## If it changes matching, delivery or a report

- [ ] A case it must handle, as a test
- [ ] A negative control: a test that fails if the check is removed
- [ ] If it touches the byte budget: a test asserting the emitted UTF-8 byte count
- [ ] If it touches a report: absent or empty input is still NOT EVALUABLE (exit 2), never a zero
- [ ] Example rules added to `examples/instincts/` are synthetic
